Listen to this article Share Laja Adeoye, Lagos State governorship candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), has described the death of Reuben Fasoranti, leader of Afenifere, the pan-Yoruba socio-political organisation, as a major loss to Yorubaland and Nigeria. Adeoye, in a condolence message issued in Lagos on Tuesday, said the late elder statesman devoted his life to education, progressive politics, Yoruba unity and good governance. Fasoranti, who died at the age of 100, was an educationist, former commissioner for finance in the old Ondo State and a pro-democracy activist known for his association with the political ideals of Obafemi Awolowo. Adeoye said he received the news of Fasoranti’s death with profound sorrow, describing him as an Omoluabi whose life was defined by service and commitment to the public good. “Pa Fasoranti lived a century of purposeful service. A distinguished educationist, former Commissioner for Finance in the old Ondo State, pro-democracy activist, and steadfast disciple of the ideals of Chief Obafemi Awolowo, he devoted his life to the advancement of Yoruba unity, progressive politics, education and good governance,” Adeoye said. He said Fasoranti’s leadership of Afenifere was marked by integrity, wisdom and a commitment to justice, adding that his voice remained influential among the Yoruba and progressive political groups across the country even in old age. According to Adeoye, Nigeria has lost a patriarch whose life embodied discipline, sacrifice and selfless service. He added that Fasoranti’s ability to endure personal tragedies with faith and dignity further reflected the strength of his character and left a legacy that would continue to inspire future generations. “On behalf of myself, my family, the Allied Peoples Movement family in Lagos State and all progressives who value his contributions, I extend heartfelt condolences to the Fasoranti family, the people of Akure and Ondo State, the entire Afenifere family and the good people of Yorubaland,” he said. Adeoye prayed for comfort and strength for the bereaved family and other mourners, saying Fasoranti’s contributions to public life would endure beyond his death. “May the gentle soul of Pa Reuben Fasoranti rest in perfect peace. His life was well lived and his legacy will endure,” he said.
